name: Cuc Phuong National Park
summary: Vietnam's first national park, 45 km northwest of the city: walk the limestone forest. An adult pays 60,000 đồng. The forest was set aside on 7 July 1962 and ranked a national park in 1966. Listed area runs from 22,200 to 25,000 ha. Primate, turtle, and carnivore visits are extra.
dotReason: A forest day west of the boats, with its own gate and rescue stops
getThere: 45 km northwest of the city, or 15 km to Bái Đính and then 26 km.
heroCaption: Karst and still water at the edge of Cúc Phương

notice.title: The rescue programs are extra
notice.body: The 60,000 đồng ticket is the gate. The primate visit is 80,000 đồng more. Turtles, carnivores, and pangolins are 60,000 đồng more. A bundled walk with a cart starts at 220,000 đồng.

body: The park sits in the Tam Điệp limestone. Decision 72/TTg of 7 July 1962 set the forest aside at 25,000 ha, on the Ninh Bình, Hòa Bình, and Thanh Hóa border. That date is also given as the start of the national park, and 1966 is also given as the year it was ranked one. Current accounts place the forest in Ninh Bình, Phú Thọ, and Thanh Hóa, and give the area as 22,200 ha and as 22,408 ha. The span to keep is 22,200 to 25,000 ha. The center of the visit is xã Cúc Phương, Nho Quan.

Walk the forest trail and, if you want the big tree, the path to the old cho. A botanical loop is about 3 km. Động Người Xưa, a prehistoric shelter in the same forest, is one of the caves on the grounds. The second frame is that trail: water in the path, canopy overhead.

Give the park its own day when the sampan already has a morning. The night cart for fireflies and animals is for people staying in the park, 150,000 đồng for an adult, and at least 600,000 đồng when the group is under five. Day visitors pay the gate as well.

figures.caption: A forest trail inside Cúc Phương, with the stream in the path
figures.alt: A shallow stream through dense green forest at Cuc Phuong National Park

gettingThere: The gate is 45 km northwest of Ninh Bình city and 120 km south of Hà Nội. From the city, one road runs through Tràng An to Bái Đính, about 15 km, then 26 km on from the parking area behind Bái Đính. The road in from thị trấn Nho Quan is under repair, so the Bái Đính road is the one in use. Another approach is Quốc lộ 1A to ngã ba Gián Khẩu, about 10 km from the city, then Quốc lộ 12A through Nho Quan and left into the park.

legs.heading: From Ninh Binh
legs.body: About 45 km northwest, or 15 km to Bái Đính and 26 km beyond the pagoda parking. The Nho Quan approach is the other road, via Gián Khẩu.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: About 120 km south. A bus leaves the park gate for bến xe Giáp Bát at 09:00 and leaves Giáp Bát for the park at 15:00.

admissionNote: Adult 60,000 đồng. Student 20,000 đồng. Pupil or child 10,000 đồng. Primate program: adult 80,000 đồng, student, pupil, or child 30,000 đồng. Turtle, carnivore, and pangolin programs: adult 60,000 đồng, reduced 30,000 đồng. A package with the gate, primates, turtles, and a cart is 220,000 đồng for an adult, 100,000 đồng for a student, and 90,000 đồng for a child, with under 6 free on that package. The fuller package, adding carnivores, pangolins, hoofed animals, birds, and the museum, is 320,000 đồng for an adult, 170,000 đồng for a student, and 160,000 đồng for a child. Night cart, for guests staying in the park: adult 150,000 đồng, child 6–10 years 100,000 đồng, under 6 years 30,000 đồng, and at least 600,000 đồng for a group under five. Hotline 02293 848 006.
